note: Roster (SmartPRS 2 → Employees → Roster). A roster row puts an employee on a Working Shift (Organization Setup → Working Shifts) for a date range; where no row covers a day the scoped shift from Working Shifts applies. The MOST RECENT row covering a date wins, so a one-day override is a one-day row saved later. Rows are never edited: cancelling one sets `cancelled_status`, which the register treats as retired.
default_mark_note: A cell with no roster row shows the employee's scoped shift from Working Shifts in a lighter tone; a roster row shows in bold.
